say:0:1721502001:0.text: Commander Hendrik, I'm so relieved to see you back.
say:0:1721502001:0.source_cn: 亨德里克卿，你的归来总算是让我安心了

say:1:1721502002:1.text: I'm ever grateful for your concern, Your Highness.

say:3:1721502003:1.text: Thank goodness he seems alright. Is he telling the prince what happened in the chapel?
say:3:1721502003:1.source_cn: 太好了……父亲看起来并没有受伤。不过，他在和王子殿下聊...

say:4:1721502004:1.text: ... Let me listen in on them!

say:2:1721504001:1.text: Commander Hendrik, what exactly happened in the Hall of Ancients?
say:2:1721504001:1.source_cn: 亨德里克卿，圣古堂里到底发生了什么事？

say:3:1721504002:1.text: Hendrik gives Prince Orion a full account of his experience in the Hall of Ancients.
say:3:1721504002:1.source_cn: 亨德里克将他在圣古堂中经历的一切，一五一十地向奥利安王...

say:5:1721504003:1.text: Your Highness, while investigating Madam Alaine's disappearance, I was swept into the Hall of Ancients by an unknown force.
say:5:1721504003:1.source_cn: 殿下，属下在调查阿莱茵女士失踪案时，被某种力量强行传送...

say:6:1721504004:2.text: I was attacked there by moving armors and Hypofiends. It seemed far more like a deliberate conspiracy than an unfortunate accident.
say:6:1721504004:2.source_cn: 在那里，属下遭遇了被魔法驱动的活动盔甲和魔物的袭击——...

say:7:1721504005:1.text: Moving armors? Hypofiends? Commander Hendrik, are you suggesting someone orchestrated the attack?
say:7:1721504005:1.source_cn: 活动盔甲？圣古堂里的魔物？亨德里克卿，你是想说这是一场...

say:8:1721504006:1.text: That's right. What weighs upon my mind is that Excalibur drew itself to vanquish the Hypofiends, an occurrence wholly without precedent. There must surely be some deeper cause at work.
say:8:1721504006:1.source_cn: 正是。更令人生疑的是，随后石中剑竟自行出鞘“驱逐”了魔...

say:9:1721504007:1.text: Alas, I was sent back before I could investigate further.
say:9:1721504007:1.source_cn: 只是……这件事情发生后属下就再次被强行传送了回来，所以...

say:11:1721504009:1.text: Since Princess Peggy and Magister Cassadee were the only ones present when the Hall of Ancients vanished, they may know more about what truly happened.
say:11:1721504009:1.source_cn: 不过，圣古堂消失时，公主殿下和魔法师科丝蒂是唯二在场的...

say:12:1721504010:1.text: But... Peggy and that court mage have yet to return.
say:12:1721504010:1.source_cn: 但佩吉她……和宫廷魔法师仍未归来。她们很可能还被困在那...

say:13:1721504011:1.text: I think they may still be trapped inside the chapel.
say:13:1721504011:1.source_cn: 我认为，她们应该还被困在那个消失的圣古堂中。

say:14:1721504012:2.text: Your Highness, whoever is behind this moves in secrecy, and their scheme poses a direct threat to the royal family. You mustn't take it lightly!
say:14:1721504012:2.source_cn: 殿下，这绝非偶然！对方手段隐秘、目标不明，已威胁到王室...

say:15:1721504013:1.text: I shall remain vigilant, naturally. Yet at present, Savannah is rife with speculation, and the people are gripped by deepening unease…
say:15:1721504013:1.source_cn: 我自然不会放松警惕。但眼下赛凡纳流言四起、人心惶惶……

say:16:1721504014:1.text: As heir to the throne, I will fulfill my duties and attend the scheduled engagement in the upper district as arranged.
say:16:1721504014:1.source_cn: 我必须履行王储的职责，今日原定的上城区公务，我仍需亲自出席。

say:17:1721504015:1.text: Your Highness, your safety must come first. Discretion is the better part of valor—while the culprit lurks in the shadows, we must proceed with caution.
say:17:1721504015:1.source_cn: 殿下，您的安全才是第一要务。幕后黑手的手段太过隐秘，我...

say:18:1721504016:1.text: I'm duty-bound to see this through, Commander Hendrik.
say:18:1721504016:1.source_cn: 这是我的责任，亨德里克卿。

say:19:1721504017:2.text: ... If you insist, please allow me to serve as your escort in the upper district.
say:19:1721504017:2.source_cn: ……既然如此，请允许属下全程随行护卫。

say:20:1721504018:1.source_cn: 好吧。那就劳烦你了，亨德里克卿。

say:23:1721504019:0.text: Gwyneth, what are you doing here?!
say:23:1721504019:0.source_cn: 格温妮丝，你怎么在这里！

say:3:1721506002:1.text: Captain Gwyneth, you owe me an explanation!
say:3:1721506002:1.source_cn: 格温妮丝队长！解释你的行为！

say:4:1721506003:1.text: Did I give you permission to leave your post? And what makes you think it is appropriate to eavesdrop on my conversation with His Highness?!
say:4:1721506003:1.source_cn: 未经许可擅离职守，还躲在暗处窃听王储的高级军事汇报？

say:5:1721506004:2.text: My apologies, Commander! I came as soon as I heard you were back! I accept full responsibility for my negligence.
say:5:1721506004:2.source_cn: 万分抱歉，司令！属下听闻王宫内有您出现的消息，一时情急...

say:7:1721506005:1.text: Don't be so harsh, Commander Hendrik. This isn't the Royal Guard base.
say:7:1721506005:1.source_cn: 好了，亨德里克卿，不必如此苛责。这里可不是军营。

say:8:1721506006:1.text: Gwyneth acted out of concern for your safety. She is your daughter, after all.
say:8:1721506006:1.source_cn: 格温妮丝也是因为担心你的安危才会乱了方寸，别对自己的女...

say:9:1721506007:1.text: I appreciate your graciousness, Your Highness, but discipline must be upheld. Captain Gwyneth, return to the base at once! Do not let this happen again!
say:9:1721506007:1.source_cn: 殿下宽容，但军纪不可废。格温妮丝队长，准备返回守备军驻...

say:12:1721506009:1.text: My apologies for the interruption, Your Highness. Let's depart right away.
say:12:1721506009:1.source_cn: 让殿下见笑了，别耽误了您的行程，我们现在出发吧。

say:14:1721506011:1.text: Orion and Hendrik stride off, surrounded by guards. Their footsteps gradually fade into the distance.
say:14:1721506011:1.source_cn: 奥利安与亨德里克在侍卫的簇拥下快步离开，脚步声逐渐消失...

say:17:1721506012:1.text: Gwyneth remains at attention until she is certain they are gone.
say:17:1721506012:1.source_cn: 格温妮丝一直维持着立正的姿势，直到确信他们已经走远。

say:18:1721506013:1.text: ... I'd only be wasting time going back to the base now. Since magic is likely involved...
say:18:1721506013:1.source_cn: ……现在返回驻地只是在浪费时间。既然此事有可能是关乎于...

say:19:1721506014:1.text: I should visit the Arcane Affairs Office and see what I can find.
say:19:1721506014:1.source_cn: 不如趁机去一躺魔法事务司，或许那会有什么线索。

say:20:1721506015:1.text: It's also where Magister Cassadee works. She seems unlikely to be the culprit, but it wouldn't hurt to confirm.
say:20:1721506015:1.source_cn: 那里也是科丝蒂的办公处，虽然她不一定与此事相关，但去确...

say:0:1721507001:0.text: The Arcane Affairs Office is located in the inner court.
say:0:1721507001:0.source_cn: 去内廷吧，魔法事务司就在那里。

say:0:1721508001:0.text: Let me do a bit of digging here.

say:1:1721509001:1.text: Excuse me, I'm Gwyneth from the Royal Guard.
say:1:1721509001:1.source_cn: 抱歉打扰了，我是守备军的格温妮丝。

say:2:1721509002:1.text: Ah! You startled me! Captain Gwyneth? What brings you here?
say:2:1721509002:1.source_cn: 啊！吓到了我……原来是守备军的格温妮丝队长啊。你怎么来...

say:3:1721509003:1.text: I'm here to gather information on Magister <style="highlight">Cassadee</style> regarding Princess Peggy's disappearance.
say:3:1721509003:1.source_cn: 我是为了佩吉公主失踪一案来的。我需要核实关于随行法师—...

say:4:1721509004:1.text: As her colleague, what's your impression of her?
say:4:1721509004:1.source_cn: 阁下是她的同僚，平时觉得她是个什么样的人？

say:5:1721509005:1.text: Cassadee? She's really nice! She doesn't talk much and spends most of her time reading, but she's the only one here willing to help me with proofreading.
say:5:1721509005:1.source_cn: 科丝蒂啊？她可是个大好人！虽然话不多，总是埋头看书，但...

say:6:1721509006:1.text: The others... they want nothing to do with me, saying I'm too clumsy. Anyway, Cassadee's incredibly hardworking, always the first in and the last out.
say:6:1721509006:1.source_cn: 不像那边那几个……老是嫌弃我笨手笨脚的。总之，她非常勤...

say:7:1721509007:1.text: She's diligent and unassuming... Has she shown any unusual behavior lately? Or been in contact with anyone suspicious?
say:7:1721509007:1.source_cn: 勤奋、低调……那她最近有什么异常举动吗？或者接触过什么...

say:8:1721509008:1.text: Not at all. Her routine is as regular as clockwork! If she's not at the library or out on duty, she's here studying magic.
say:8:1721509008:1.source_cn: 完全没有。她的生活简直比炼金时钟还规律。除了去图书馆和...

say:9:1721509009:1.text: Sounds like she's very dedicated to her work. When did she begin serving as a court mage?
say:9:1721509009:1.source_cn: 这么看来，她确实很优秀。那她是什么时候加入的宫廷魔法师团？

say:10:1721509010:1.text: Since she took first place in the recent selection exam of the <style="highlight">Serene Lyceum</style>.

say:12:1721509012:1.text: Yes, that exam was a major event! Even the Queen and Princess Peggy attended.
say:12:1721509012:1.source_cn: 对啊！那次选拔我印象可深了！规模很大，连王后陛下和佩吉...

say:13:1721509013:1.text: <style="highlight">Magister Cyran</style> went there several times as well. It was so good when he wasn't around—I could finally rest... I mean, work at my own pace!

say:14:1721509014:1.text: Anyway, Cassadee's victory was no easy feat, especially with a member of House Hastings among her competitors.
say:14:1721509014:1.source_cn: 与她同场竞争的还有黑斯廷斯家族的小少爷，结果……嘿！科...

say:15:1721509015:1.text: Did anything out of the ordinary take place during her time here?
say:15:1721509015:1.source_cn: 科丝蒂就职后呢，有没有什么特别的事？

say:16:1721509016:1.text: Hmm, I don't think so. She doesn't seem to be in Magister Cyran's good graces, so she's mostly stuck with menial paperwork.
say:16:1721509016:1.source_cn: 唔，那倒是没有，毕竟首席好像不是很喜欢她，平时只丢给她...

say:17:1721509017:1.text: If that's the case, why was she assigned to escort Princess Peggy during the festival? Isn't that an important duty?
say:17:1721509017:1.source_cn: 既然如此，这次升华庆典这么重要的场合，为什么是科丝蒂跟...

say:18:1721509018:1.text: Oh, that one I know! Princess Peggy made a special request for Cassadee's service.
say:18:1721509018:1.source_cn: 哦，这个我知道！这是公主殿下自己的要求。公主殿下好像很...

say:19:1721509019:1.text: I see. Thank you for sharing this, Magister Dali. I'd like to take a look at Cassadee's desk. Could you point me to it?
say:19:1721509019:1.source_cn: 我明白了。多谢你的情报，达利阁下。科丝蒂的工位在哪里？...

say:20:1721509020:1.text: The tidiest one in that corner! I just hope Cassadee's alright...
say:20:1721509020:1.source_cn: 就在那边角落里！最整齐的那张桌子就是！唉，希望她没事！

say:2:1721510002:0.text: Oh, isn't this Captain Gwyneth? What are you doing here? The smell of parchment here must be a bit much for you, huh?
say:2:1721510002:0.source_cn: 哎呀，这不是格温妮丝队长吗？什么风把您吹到我们这全是羊...

say:3:1721510003:2.text: I don't suppose your duties include cleaning our crystal balls?
say:3:1721510003:2.source_cn: 守备军的巡逻任务应该不包括帮我们擦水晶球吧？

say:4:1721510004:0.text: I'm here to investigate the Hall of Ancients' disappearance.
say:4:1721510004:0.source_cn: 我是为了圣古堂消失一案来的。

say:5:1721510005:0.text: Has the Arcane Affairs Office issued any report on the incident?
say:5:1721510005:0.source_cn: 事发已经过去一段时间，魔法事务司对圣古堂消失的原因是否...

say:6:1721510006:2.text: Hmm... you don't know much about magic, do you? No wonder you'd ask such a naive question.
say:6:1721510006:2.source_cn: 看来，您是不懂魔法，所以才会问出……这么天真的问题。

say:7:1721510007:0.text: Let me break it down for you—spatial magic is among the most advanced branches of magic, and causing an entire building to vanish is no walk in the park.
say:7:1721510007:0.source_cn: 空间魔法可是最高深的领域，更别提是一整座建筑凭空消失了！

say:8:1721510008:0.text: We have, in accordance with Chapter 3, Article 5 of the Magical Incident Response Protocol, collected samples of residual magic from multiple locations across the site.
say:8:1721510008:0.source_cn: 我们已经依照《魔法事故处理条例》第三章第五条，对现场残...

say:10:1721510010:0.text: Well, <style="highlight">the situation is too complicated</style> to draw any firm conclusions. We haven't found any useful leads.

say:12:1721510012:0.text: I'm afraid you'd need to be a mage to grasp the intricacies of this matter. Even if you press me, there's nothing more I can tell you.
say:12:1721510012:0.source_cn: 术业有专攻。您催我也没用。

say:13:1721510013:0.text: Besides, don't you know the Queen has already put <style="highlight">Magister Merlin</style> in charge?
say:13:1721510013:0.source_cn: 再说了，这件案子，王后陛下不是已经委托给<style=...
say:13:1721510013:0.male: Besides, don't you know the Queen has already put <style="highlight">Magister Merlin</style> in charge?
say:13:1721510013:0.female: Besides, don't you know the Queen has already put <style="highlight">Magister Merlin</style> in charge?

say:14:1721510014:0.text: That doesn't mean you can stand idle. It's your job to work on the case.
say:14:1721510014:0.source_cn: 这与梅林阁下有什么关系？这也是你们的本职工作之一。
say:14:1721510014:0.male: That doesn't mean you can stand idle. It's your job to work on the case.
say:14:1721510014:0.female: That doesn't mean you can stand idle. It's your job to work on the case.

say:15:1721510015:2.text: I'm not sure I agree with that. You see, Magister Merlin's the <style="highlight">First Seat of the Arcane Council</style>. He's a legend among mages.
say:15:1721510015:2.source_cn: 怎么没关系？梅林阁下可是<style=highligh...
say:15:1721510015:2.male: I'm not sure I agree with that. You see, Magister Merlin's the <style="highlight">First Seat of the Arcane Council</style>. He's a legend among mages.
say:15:1721510015:2.female: I'm not sure I agree with that. You see, Magister Merlin's the <style="highlight">First Seat of the Arcane Council</style>. She's a legend among mages.

say:16:1721510016:0.text: If he can't get to the bottom of it, what makes you think we can?
say:16:1721510016:0.male: If he can't get to the bottom of it, what makes you think we can?
say:16:1721510016:0.female: If she can't get to the bottom of it, what makes you think we can?

say:17:1721510017:0.text: Captain Gwyneth, just head back and wait for word from Magister Merlin. There's no need to make things difficult for us.
say:17:1721510017:0.source_cn: 格温妮丝队长，你们守备军还是回去等梅林阁下的消息吧，别...
say:17:1721510017:0.male: Captain Gwyneth, just head back and wait for word from Magister Merlin. There's no need to make things difficult for us.
say:17:1721510017:0.female: Captain Gwyneth, just head back and wait for word from Magister Merlin. There's no need to make things difficult for us.

say:0:1721511001:0.text: It's time to take a look at Cassadee's desk.
say:0:1721511001:0.source_cn: 看来没什么线索了，只能先看看科丝蒂的工位了。

say:1:1721512001:1.text: The timetable is neatly written, with every hour carefully planned. Just as Dali mentioned, Cassadee is highly disciplined and diligent.
say:1:1721512001:1.source_cn: 这份日程表字迹工整，时间安排得满满当当。正如达利所说，...

say:2:1721512002:1.source_cn: 看起来在此之前并没有什么特别的地方。

say:3:1721512003:1.text: I think I've learned everything I can from here. Let me head back to the base.
say:3:1721512003:1.source_cn: 魔法事务司这里应该没什么线索了，先返回驻地吧。

say:1:1721513001:1.text: Well, well, look who's back—the Royal Guard's rising star! What's the hurry? Is she working on the Hall of Ancients case?
say:1:1721513001:1.source_cn: 哟，瞧瞧是谁回来了？咱们守备军的大明星啊。这么急匆匆的...

say:2:1721513002:1.text: She can't even if she wants to. Haven't you heard? The commander has barred her from the case.
say:2:1721513002:1.source_cn: 别傻了。没听说吗？司令下了命令，严禁某些人参与此案。

say:3:1721513003:1.text: Of course, the commander wouldn't let his beloved daughter handle such a dangerous case! What if she dirties that spotless armor of hers?
say:3:1721513003:1.source_cn: 这么危险的案子，司令大人怎么舍得让他那娇贵的女儿去冒险...

say:4:1721513004:1.text: She must be crushed to have missed her moment in the spotlight at the parade. Probably spent a week polishing that gleaming armor…
say:4:1721513004:1.source_cn: 真是遗憾。本来庆典上的军事献演可是某人的高光时刻。为了...

say:5:1721513005:1.text: And now, with everyone talking about the missing chapel, no one even remembers her.
say:5:1721513005:1.source_cn: 圣古堂没了，所有人的注意都被夺走了，这下没人记得她的英姿了。

say:8:1721513006:0.text: That's enough, Guyse and Hurron! Show some respect!
say:8:1721513006:0.source_cn: 盖伊、呼伦，住口！你们放尊重点——

say:10:1721513007:0.text: Wow, someone's already rushing to her defense. See? That's the privilege of coming from a prestigious family.
say:10:1721513007:0.source_cn: 噢——有人急了。看到了吗？这就是有个伟大家族的好处。

say:11:1721513008:0.text: She doesn't have to lift a finger. There are plenty of loyal lapdogs eager to bark on her behalf.
say:11:1721513008:0.source_cn: 根本不需要自己开口，只要站在那里，就会有忠诚的卫士跳出...

say:12:1721513009:1.text: If I were Commander Hendrik's son, I could land a captain's post without earning it.
say:12:1721513009:1.source_cn: 可不是嘛。如果我父亲是耀光之盾，哪怕我只会拿着木剑挥舞...

say:13:1721513010:1.text: Martin, is your name already on the promotion list? That would explain the brown-nosing.
say:13:1721513010:1.source_cn: 马丁，你这么卖力地表现，之后的晋升名单上肯定有你吧？

say:14:1721513011:0.text: You've gone too far! I challenge you to a duel! Whoever loses apologizes!
say:14:1721513011:0.source_cn: 你们，岂有此理！我要向你们发起决斗，谁输了谁道歉！

say:18:1721513013:0.text: Captain, they're badmouthing you and the commander! That's out of line!
say:18:1721513013:0.source_cn: 可是队长！这帮家伙……他们在侮辱您和司令的名誉！这绝对...

say:19:1721513014:0.text: We can't control what others think of us, but you must remember what your weapon stands for. It was forged to defend your homeland, not to be turned against your own.
say:19:1721513014:0.source_cn: 那是他们的舌头，但武器握在你手里。你的武器是为了守卫耀...

say:21:1721513016:1.text: Follow me. If they think we're riding on our family name, we'll prove them wrong with our skill. Double the slashing drills today.
say:21:1721513016:1.source_cn: 跟我来。既然有人觉得我们只是靠家族名声的花瓶，那就用实...

say:25:1721513018:1.text: Tsk... I can't stand her acting like she's better than everyone else.

say:1:1721514001:0.text: *Huff*... *Huff*... I can't carry on, Captain! My arms are going to fall off!
say:1:1721514001:0.source_cn: 呼……呼……不行了，队长！我的胳膊要断了！

say:2:1721514002:0.text: You're incredibly strong! I can barely draw your bow...
say:2:1721514002:0.source_cn: 您的力气太大了！您用的弓我完全拉不开……

say:3:1721514003:0.text: But you can hit the bullseye repeatedly from afar... That's astounding!
say:3:1721514003:0.source_cn: 而您竟然能拉着它在百步外连续命中靶心……太不可思议了！

say:4:1721514004:1.text: That's because you're a swordsman, and I'm an archer. While you rely on explosive strength, I rely on patience and stability.
say:4:1721514004:1.source_cn: 弓箭手和剑士不同，马丁。剑士依赖爆发力，而我们依赖的是...

say:5:1721514005:0.text: When your heart rate rises, your accuracy begins to falter.
say:5:1721514005:0.source_cn: 当心跳干扰到瞄准的那一刻，你手中的箭就已经偏离了目标。

say:6:1721514006:0.text: Got it! If I can achieve even a fraction of your skill, those gossiping idiots will get off my back!
say:6:1721514006:0.source_cn: 属下受教了！只要能练出队长您三成的本事，看那帮碎嘴的家...

say:7:1721514007:0.text: I'll retrieve the arrows. Get some rest, Captain!
say:7:1721514007:0.source_cn: 那我先去回收箭矢了！队长您也早点休息！

say:8:1721514008:1.text: Go on. Remember to maintain your weapon after training.
say:8:1721514008:1.source_cn: 去吧，训练完记得保养武器。

say:0:1721515001:0.text: I feel like trying a new beeswax on my bowstring...
say:0:1721515001:0.source_cn: 我也去保养弓弦，这次换新的蜂蜡试试。

narration:0:1721516001:0.text: As Gwyneth meticulously cleans her bowstring, Merlin is on his way to the base.
narration:0:1721516001:0.source_cn: 格温妮丝细致地擦拭着弓弦，而此时，梅林正在前往守备军基...
narration:0:1721516001:0.male: As Gwyneth meticulously cleans her bowstring, Merlin is on his way to the base.
narration:0:1721516001:0.female: As Gwyneth meticulously cleans her bowstring, Merlin is on her way to the base.
